caption:
Reach is not a result. Impressions are not a result. Engagement is not a result.

A customer is a result.

All three of those can climb while your revenue sits exactly where it was. That is precisely why they lead the report — there is always a good number available.

Here is the test for any marketing report you get. Can you draw a line from that number to money in the bank?

If you can't, it is a vanity metric in a suit.

📌 Send this to whoever sends you a monthly report full of reach.
